title: A 1% fee costs more than you think
caption:
$100,000 invested for 30 years:
At 7% a year: $761,226
At 6% (after a 1% fee): $574,349
That 1% fee cost $186,876.
Always check the fees.
comment: Do you know what fees you pay? 👇

scenes.say: A one percent fee sounds tiny.
Invest one hundred thousand dollars for thirty years at seven percent.
Now pay one percent in fees, so you earn six.
That one percent fee cost you about a hundred and eighty-seven thousand dollars.
